description: This file defines the BaseMessageFilter class which provides utility methods to verify the existence and correctness of mandatory message properties in AMQP messages, specifically for device ID validation, resource verification, and correlation ID presence.

classes.name: BaseMessageFilter
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to verify standard properties of AMQP messages, such as device ID correctness, resource consistency, and message ID presence.

methods.name: verifyStandardProperties
methods.description: Checks if the message contains valid device ID and annotates it with resource info if valid.

methods.name: hasValidDeviceId
methods.description: Verifies that the message contains a valid device ID that matches the link target resource criteria.

methods.name: hasCorrelationId
methods.description: Checks if the message contains either a message ID or a correlation ID for message correlation.
